citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 1: Fixed Deposit Tenures, Interest Rates, and Senior Citizen A
text: Section 1: Fixed Deposit Tenures, Interest Rates, and Senior Citizen Advantage FinBase offers digital Fixed Deposits starting with a minimum deposit of ₹1,000 up to ₹50,00,000 per booking: Tenure Bucket Regular Customer Rate (p.a.) Senior Citizen Rate (60+ yrs) Compounding Frequency 7 days to 180 days 5.50% p.a. 6.00% p.a. At Maturity 181 days to 364 days 6.25% p.a. 6.75% p.a. Quarterly Compounded 1 year to less than 2 years 7.50% p.a. 8.00% p.a. Quarterly Compounded 2 years to 3 years 7.25% p.a. 7.75% p.a. Quarterly Compounded 3 years to 5 years 7.00% p.a. 7.50% p.a. Quarterly Compounded • Senior Citizen Rate Advantage: Senior citizen depositors aged 60 years and above are entitled to an additional interest rate of **0.50% p.a.** across all deposit tenures.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 2: Premature Liquidation and Penalties
text: Section 2: Premature Liquidation and Penalties • Premature Withdrawal Permitted: Customers may break or liquidate their Fixed Deposit at any time through the FinBase App. • Premature Penalty: A penalty of **1.00%** is deducted from the contracted interest rate applicable for the period the FD actually remained open. • 7-Day Minimum Holding Rule: If a Fixed Deposit is closed prematurely within 7 days from the booking date, **zero interest** is payable under RBI regulations.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 3: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) & Form 15G / 15H
text: Section 3: Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) & Form 15G / 15H • TDS Threshold: TDS is deducted at 10% if the total annual interest income across all deposits exceeds ₹40,000 in a financial year (₹50,000 for senior citizens). • Non-PAN Penalty: If a valid PAN is not linked to the customer account, TDS is statutorily deducted at 20%. • Zero TDS Exemption (Form 15G/15H): • Depositors whose estimated total annual income is below the taxable threshold may submit Form 15G (for individuals below 60 years) or Form 15H (for senior citizens aged 60+) digitally via the FinBase App to avoid TDS deduction.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 4: FinBase Wealth — Mutual Funds & SIP
text: Section 4: FinBase Wealth — Mutual Funds & SIP • Direct Mutual Funds: FinBase Wealth provides access to over 1,500+ Direct Mutual Fund schemes with **0% distributor commission**. • Minimum Systematic Investment Plan (SIP): Start investing with as low as **₹100 per month**. • Redemption Turnaround: Redemption proceeds are credited directly to your FinBase Savings Account within T+1 to T+3 business days depending on scheme category.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 5: FinBase Wealth — 24K Digital Gold and Silver
text: Section 5: FinBase Wealth — 24K Digital Gold and Silver • Purity & Storage: 24 Karat 99.9% pure digital gold backed by physical bullion stored in secure, insured vaults managed by MMTC-PAMP. • Minimum Purchase: Customers can buy digital gold starting from as low as **₹10**. • Physical Delivery: Digital gold balances can be redeemed into physical minted gold coins/bars starting at 1 gram, delivered securely to the customer's doorstep.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — Section 22: Explicit Product Exclusions & Unsupported Services Policy
text: Section 22: Explicit Product Exclusions & Unsupported Services Policy To prevent customer confusion and combat financial scams, FinBase explicitly defines services that are strictly NOT offered or supported on its platform: • Cryptocurrency & Virtual Digital Assets: FinBase does **NOT** provide cryptocurrency trading, Bitcoin/Ethereum wallets, or virtual digital asset exchange facilities. • Agricultural Property Loans: FinBase does **NOT** offer loans against agricultural farmland or rural mortgage loans. • Speculative Intraday Tips: FinBase does **NOT** provide daily stock market intraday calls, F&O options tips, or speculative trading advice. • Unregulated Chit Funds / Ponzi Schemes: Strictly prohibited under compliance governance. Customer support assistants must clearly state that these services are unsupported and unavailable in the FinBase knowledge base.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: What is the interest rate for senior citizens on a 1-year Fixed Deposit? (Wealth product query 1) Under Section 1, senior citizens (aged 60 and above) receive an extra 0.50% p.a. over the regular rate of 7.50% p.a., earning an effective rate of 8.00% p.a. on a 1 to 2-year FD. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-001]. • Instrument Category: Product code WLT-CAT-02. • Risk-o-meter Rating: Calibrated under SEBI Risk Guidelines WLTH-SEBI-0001. • Tax implication: Subject to Income Tax Act Section 194A / Capital Gains Rules. • Verification reference: Form 26AS integration and quarterly statement synchronization.

(Wealth product query 12) Under Section 2, a penalty of 1.00% is deducted from the applicable interest rate for the period the deposit actually ran. If closed within 7 days, zero interest is paid. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-012]. • Instrument Category: Product code WLT-CAT-01. • Risk-o-meter Rating: Calibrated under SEBI Risk Guidelines WLTH-SEBI-0012. • Tax implication: Subject to Income Tax Act Section 194A / Capital Gains Rules. • Verification reference: Form 26AS integration and quarterly statement synchronization.

citation: FinBase Fixed Deposits & Wealth Products Master Guidelines — FAQ Q013
text: Q013: How can I avoid TDS deduction on my fixed deposit interest earnings? (Wealth product query 13) Under Section 3, eligible customers whose annual total income is below the taxable threshold can submit Form 15G (or Form 15H for senior citizens) digitally in the FinBase App to prevent TDS. [Reference Wealth Guidelines: Clause WLTH-POL-013]. • Instrument Category: Product code WLT-CAT-02. • Risk-o-meter Rating: Calibrated under SEBI Risk Guidelines WLTH-SEBI-0013. • Tax implication: Subject to Income Tax Act Section 194A / Capital Gains Rules. • Verification reference: Form 26AS integration and quarterly statement synchronization.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — Preamble
text: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP Document Code: FB-SOP-PAY-2026-V4 Effective Date: October 1, 2026 Issuing Authority: FinBase Payments & Settlement Compliance Division Classification: Standard Operating Procedure & Customer Dispute Terms Table of Contents

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — Section 1: UPI Limits and 24-Hour Security Cooling Period
text: Section 1: UPI Limits and 24-Hour Security Cooling Period • Standard Daily UPI Limit: Up to ₹1,00,000 per calendar day across peer-to-peer (P2P) transfers. • Transaction Frequency Limit: Maximum 20 outbound UPI payments per rolling 24-hour window. • First 24-Hour Cooling Period Security Restriction: • Whenever a customer links a new bank account or resets their UPI PIN, NPCI security protocols enforce a strict cooling period. • Outward UPI payments are restricted to a maximum cumulative limit of ₹5,000 for the initial 24 hours following the PIN reset. • Full ₹1,00,000 daily limit automatically unlocks exactly 24 hours after PIN registration.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — Section 2: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT)
text: Section 2: Failed Transactions and Auto-Reversal Turnaround Time (TAT) When money is debited from a customer's account but the transaction fails or the beneficiary does not receive the credit: • Mandatory Auto-Reversal TAT: Under RBI and NPCI Harmonization of TAT guidelines, failed transactions must be automatically reversed and credited back to the customer's account within **T+2 business days** (where T is the transaction date). • Delayed Reversal Compensation: • If the reversal takes longer than T+2 business days, FinBase compensates the customer ₹100 per calendar day of delay. • Compensation is calculated from the expiry of the T+2 window until the exact credit date, deposited directly into the customer's account without requiring any manual claim submission.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — Section 3: Merchant Disputes, Chargebacks, and Provisional Credit
text: Section 3: Merchant Disputes, Chargebacks, and Provisional Credit • Customers can dispute unauthorized, double, or incorrect merchant debits through the FinBase App under 'Transaction Details -> Report Issue' within 3 calendar days of transaction occurrence. • For eligible merchant disputes, provisional credit is credited to the customer's savings account within 7 working days while bank arbitration proceeds.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — Section 4: Payment Gateway Mechanics & Settlement Standards 4
text: Section 4: Payment Gateway Mechanics & Settlement Standards 4 Payment SOP FB-PAY-MEC-004 details reconciliation across NPCI switches, partner bank sponsor gateways, and settlement nodes. Every electronic message packet is verified with cryptographic checksums, SHA-256 HMAC tokens, and multi-rail failover redundancy. • Protocol 4.1: Auto-retry logic on temporary network timeout (HTTP 504 / U69 responses). • Protocol 4.2: Merchant QR dynamic payload parsing and BharatQR compatibility. • Protocol 4.3: Mandate execution retry schedule for recurring OTT and SIP debits. • Protocol 4.4: P2M refund settlement batches and NEFT fallback mechanisms. • Protocol 4.5: Regulatory reporting to RBI Central Payments Fraud Information Registry (CPFIR). • Protocol 4.6: Offline UPI 123Pay voice payments reconciliation standards. • Protocol 4.7: Cross-border UPI merchant transactions via NIPL international gateways. citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: My UPI transaction failed but money was deducted. When will I receive a refund? (Payment incident case 1) Under Section 2, failed UPI debits are automatically credited back within T+2 business days under RBI and NPCI guidelines. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-001]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 2. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0001. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q002
text: Q002: What compensation is payable if my failed transaction refund is delayed? (Payment incident case 2) Under Section 2, if the auto-reversal exceeds T+2 business days, FinBase compensates you ₹100 per calendar day of delay directly into your account. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-002]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 3. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0002. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q003
text: Q003: What is the UPI transfer limit during the first 24 hours of resetting my PIN? (Payment incident case 3) Under Section 1, there is a security cooling period restricting outward UPI payments to a maximum of ₹5,000 for the first 24 hours after a PIN reset. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-003]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 4. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0003. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q004
text: Q004: What is the standard daily transaction limit for UPI payments? (Payment incident case 4) Under Section 1, the daily UPI limit is ₹1,00,000 or a maximum of 20 outbound transactions per rolling 24-hour window. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-004]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 5. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0004. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q005
text: Q005: How do I raise a dispute for an unauthorized debit on my account? (Payment incident case 5) Under Section 3, you can dispute the transaction directly in the FinBase App under 'Transaction Details -> Report Issue' within 3 calendar days. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-005]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 1. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0005. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q006
text: Q006: When do I get provisional credit for a disputed merchant transaction? (Payment incident case 6) Under Section 3, eligible disputed merchant transactions receive provisional credit within 7 business days while bank arbitration proceeds. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-006]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 2. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0006. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q007
text: Q007: Can I cancel a completed UPI payment? (Payment incident case 7) No. UPI transactions are instant and irrevocable once completed. If sent to the wrong person, contact the recipient or file a wrong credit dispute. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-007]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 3. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0007. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q008
text: Q008: Why did my UPI payment fail with response code U69? (Payment incident case 8) Response code U69 indicates a temporary network timeout between the switch and the beneficiary bank. Auto-reversal initiates within T+2 days if debited. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-008]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 4. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0008. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

citation: FinBase Payments, UPI & Refund Settlement SOP — FAQ Q009
text: Q009: Does FinBase charge any fee for UPI transactions? (Payment incident case 9) No, FinBase does not charge any fee for peer-to-peer (P2P) or merchant (P2M) UPI transactions. [Reference Payments SOP Section: Clause PAY-SOP-009]. • Switch Route: NPCI UPI 2.0 Central Clearing Switch node 5. • Reconciliation code: Auto-reconciled under batch job PAY-REC-0009. • Verification reference: NPCI Universal Transaction Reference (UTR) 12-digit key. • Dispute turnaround time: 48 business hours.

text: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement Document Code: FB-POL-CC-2026-V5 Effective Date: October 1, 2026 Issuing Authority: FinBase Cards & Payments Governance Board Classification: Official Customer Product Terms & Cardholder Disclosure Table of Contents

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — Section 1: Introduction and Card Tiers Overview
text: Section 1: Introduction and Card Tiers Overview FinBase issues credit cards on the Visa and RuPay payment networks. This handbook outlines the contractual terms, charges, credit limits, grace periods, and reward structures governing all card variants.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 1.1 FinBase Neo Credit Card (Lifetime Free)
text: 1.1 FinBase Neo Credit Card (Lifetime Free) • Joining & Renewal Fee: Lifetime Free (Zero joining fee, Zero annual fee forever). • Rewards & Cashback: Flat 1.0% unlimited cashback on all eligible retail POS and online e-commerce transactions. • Exclusions: Fuel purchases, wallet reload transactions, cash withdrawals, and government utility payments do not earn cashback. • Airport Lounge Access: No complimentary airport lounge access is included on the Neo tier. • Foreign Currency Markup: 3.50% on all cross-border and foreign currency transactions.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 1.2 FinBase Luxe Credit Card (Lifestyle & Travel)
text: 1.2 FinBase Luxe Credit Card (Lifestyle & Travel) • Joining & Annual Fee: ₹999 + 18% GST. • Annual Fee Waiver: The annual fee for subsequent years is 100% waived if the total annual card spend exceeds ₹1,20,000 in the preceding membership year. • Rewards: 2.0% cashback on online e-commerce transactions, 1.0% cashback on in-store offline POS swipes. • Airport Lounge Access: 4 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per calendar year (strictly capped at 1 visit per calendar quarter). • Foreign Currency Markup Fee: Reduced markup of 1.50% on all international and foreign currency payments (industry standard is 3.50%).

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 1.3 FinBase Metal Credit Card (Ultra-Premium)
text: 1.3 FinBase Metal Credit Card (Ultra-Premium) • Joining & Annual Fee: ₹4,999 + 18% GST. • Annual Fee Waiver: Waived upon crossing ₹5,00,000 in annual retail spending. • Rewards: 3.5% reward points on flights, hotels, fine dining, and international transactions; 1.5% on other retail categories. • Lounge Privileges: Unlimited complimentary domestic airport lounge access for primary cardholder, plus 4 complimentary international lounge visits per calendar year via Priority Pass. • Foreign Currency Markup Fee: Industry-leading 1.00% markup on international transactions. • Concierge: 24/7 global lifestyle and travel concierge desk.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — Section 2: Credit Limit Assignment and Enhancement
text: Section 2: Credit Limit Assignment and Enhancement • Initial credit limits are determined based on bureau score, verifiable income, and existing credit lines. • Automated Limit Enhancement: Evaluated every 6 months for accounts demonstrating 100% on-time minimum payment track record and credit utilization maintained below 40%. • Temporary Limit Enhancements: Available for festive or medical emergencies through in-app approval for up to 30 days.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — Section 3: Billing Cycle, Grace Period, and Minimum Amount Due (MAD)
text: Section 3: Billing Cycle, Grace Period, and Minimum Amount Due (MAD)

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 3.1 Interest-Free Grace Period Cardholders enjoy an interest-free cred
text: 3.1 Interest-Free Grace Period Cardholders enjoy an interest-free credit grace period ranging between 45 to 50 days, depending on transaction date. The grace period is applicable ONLY if the Total Amount Due from the previous billing cycle was settled in full by the due date.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 3.2 Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Calculation
text: 3.2 Minimum Amount Due (MAD) Calculation • MAD is calculated as 5% of the total outstanding balance, or ₹250 (whichever is higher), plus all applicable taxes, EMI installments, and overdue amounts from prior cycles. • Paying only the Minimum Amount Due keeps the account in good standing with credit bureaus but attracts finance charges on the remaining unpaid balance.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — 3.3 Finance Charges and Annual Percentage Rate (APR)
text: 3.3 Finance Charges and Annual Percentage Rate (APR) • Unpaid statement balances attract interest at 3.49% per month (effective 41.88% per annum), calculated from transaction date until full realization. • Cash advances from ATMs do not enjoy any grace period; interest accrues from the timestamp of cash withdrawal at 3.49% per month.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — Section 4: Credit Card Processing Rules & Security Standards 4
text: Section 4: Credit Card Processing Rules & Security Standards 4 FinBase Credit Card Operations Standard FB-CCO-004 outlines tokenization, fraud scoring, and chargeback protocols. Every transaction is analyzed in real-time by the neural risk engine for geographic anomalies, velocity bursts, and merchant category risks. • Rule 4.1: Contactless tap-to-pay transaction limits without PIN capped at ₹5,000 per transaction. • Rule 4.2: Mandatory dynamic CVV generation for online merchant tokenization. • Rule 4.3: Dynamic currency conversion (DCC) warnings and merchant markup transparency. • Rule 4.4: Fraud alert telemetry and automatic risk step-up authentication. • Rule 4.5: Merchant dispute filing workflows under Visa and RuPay chargeback rules. • Rule 4.6: Virtual add-on card issuance limits for family members. • Rule 4.7: EMI conversion interest rates starting from 14% p.a. for transactions above ₹2,500. citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: What is the foreign currency markup on the FinBase Luxe card? (Card operational case 1) Under Section 1.2, the foreign currency markup fee on the FinBase Luxe Credit Card is 1.50% on all international transactions. [Reference Cardholder Agreement Section: Clause CC-RULE-001]. • Tier Scope: Applicable to Neo, Luxe, and Metal cardholders under standard agreement. • Billing Engine Code: Verified under automated billing script CC-BILL-0001. • Customer notification: Communicated via monthly e-statement and instant transaction SMS alert. • Dispute window: Cardholders may report billing discrepancies within 30 days of statement generation.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — FAQ Q002
text: Q002: What is the annual fee for the FinBase Luxe card and how can I get it waived? (Card operational case 2) The annual fee is ₹999 + 18% GST. As per Section 1.2, it is 100% waived if your total annual spends exceed ₹1,20,000 in the previous calendar year. [Reference Cardholder Agreement Section: Clause CC-RULE-002]. • Tier Scope: Applicable to Neo, Luxe, and Metal cardholders under standard agreement. • Billing Engine Code: Verified under automated billing script CC-BILL-0002. • Customer notification: Communicated via monthly e-statement and instant transaction SMS alert. • Dispute window: Cardholders may report billing discrepancies within 30 days of statement generation.

citation: FinBase Credit Cards Comprehensive Handbook & Cardholder Agreement — FAQ Q003
text: Q003: Does the FinBase Neo card have any annual or joining fees? (Card operational case 3) No. Under Section 1.1, the FinBase Neo Credit Card is 100% Lifetime Free with zero joining and zero renewal fees. [Reference Cardholder Agreement Section: Clause CC-RULE-003]. • Tier Scope: Applicable to Neo, Luxe, and Metal cardholders under standard agreement. • Billing Engine Code: Verified under automated billing script CC-BILL-0003. • Customer notification: Communicated via monthly e-statement and instant transaction SMS alert. • Dispute window: Cardholders may report billing discrepancies within 30 days of statement generation.

text: Q004: How many complimentary airport lounge visits come with the FinBase Luxe card? [Reference Cardholder Agreement Section: Clause CC-RULE-004]. • Tier Scope: Applicable to Neo, Luxe, and Metal cardholders under standard agreement. • Billing Engine Code: Verified under automated billing script CC-BILL-0004. • Customer notification: Communicated via monthly e-statement and instant transaction SMS alert. • Dispute window: Cardholders may report billing discrepancies within 30 days of statement generation.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — Section 1: Account Features and Minimum Balance Terms
text: Section 1: Account Features and Minimum Balance Terms • Zero Minimum Balance: The FinBase Digital Savings Account operates on a 100% zero-balance structure. There is no Minimum Average Balance (MAB) requirement. • Zero Penalty: Customers face zero penalty fees or account maintenance charges for maintaining a low or zero balance. • Account Opening: Paperless digital onboarding via Aadhaar OTP and Video KYC in under 5 minutes. • Virtual Debit Card: Instant free virtual RuPay/Visa Platinum debit card issued upon account creation.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — Section 2: Tiered Savings Account Interest Rate Slabs
text: Section 2: Tiered Savings Account Interest Rate Slabs FinBase calculates interest on daily end-of-day balances, credited quarterly to the account on March 31, June 30, September 30, and December 31: Daily Balance Slab Annual Interest Rate (p.a.) Calculation Basis Up to ₹1,00,000 3.50% p.a. Daily ledger closing balance Above ₹1,00,000 and up to ₹10,00,000 6.00% p.a. Incremental balance above ₹1L Above ₹10,00,000 7.00% p.a. Incremental balance above ₹10L Interest is compounded on a quarterly basis and deposited directly into the savings account.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — Section 3: Electronic Fund Transfer Limits & Charges
text: Section 3: Electronic Fund Transfer Limits & Charges • UPI Transfers: 100% Free. Daily cumulative limit of ₹1,00,000 with a maximum of 20 outbound transactions per rolling 24-hour window. • IMPS (Immediate Payment Service): Free for all active account holders, up to ₹5,00,000 per calendar day. • NEFT & RTGS Transfers: Completely free with zero transaction fees and no upper limit for Full-KYC accounts. • ATM Cash Withdrawals: • FinBase Partner ATMs: 5 free cash withdrawals per calendar month. • Non-Partner ATMs: 3 free withdrawals per month in metro cities (5 in non-metro locations). • Subsequent ATM cash withdrawals beyond the free allowance incur a fee of ₹21 + 18% GST per transaction.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: What is the minimum balance required for a FinBase Digital Savings Account? (Operational inquiry 1) Under Section 1, the account is a zero-balance account with no Minimum Average Balance (MAB) requirement and zero penalty for maintaining a zero balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-001]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-02. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0001. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q002
text: Q002: What interest rate do I get if my account balance is ₹5,00,000? (Operational inquiry 2) Under Section 2, the first ₹1,00,000 earns 3.50% p.a., while the incremental ₹4,00,000 earns 6.00% p.a. Interest is calculated on daily closing balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-002]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-03. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0002. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q003
text: Q003: What is the maximum interest rate offered on savings accounts? (Operational inquiry 3) Under Section 2, balances exceeding ₹10,00,000 earn 7.00% p.a. on the incremental balance above ₹10 Lakhs. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-003]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-01. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0003. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

(Operational inquiry 11) Under Section 1, the account is a zero-balance account with no Minimum Average Balance (MAB) requirement and zero penalty for maintaining a zero balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-011]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-03. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0011. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q012
text: Q012: What interest rate do I get if my account balance is ₹5,00,000? (Operational inquiry 12) Under Section 2, the first ₹1,00,000 earns 3.50% p.a., while the incremental ₹4,00,000 earns 6.00% p.a. Interest is calculated on daily closing balance. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-012]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-01. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0012. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q013
text: Q013: What is the maximum interest rate offered on savings accounts? (Operational inquiry 13) Under Section 2, balances exceeding ₹10,00,000 earn 7.00% p.a. on the incremental balance above ₹10 Lakhs. [Reference Savings Account Manual Section: Clause SAV-RULE-013]. • Account Classification: Retail savings tier SAV-CAT-02. • Verification engine: Real-time ledger audit module SAV-AUD-0013. • Statement proof: Visible in quarterly account statements and downloadable TDS certificates. • Support resolution SLA: Immediate resolution via automated banking chatbot.

citation: FinBase Digital Savings Accounts & Banking Operations Manual — FAQ Q014
text: Q014: How many free ATM withdrawals are available each month? citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Preamble
text: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual Document Code: FB-POL-PL-2026-V4 Effective Date: October 1, 2026 Issuing Authority: FinBase Credit & Underwriting Risk Committee Classification: Official Customer Policy & Knowledge Base Table of Contents

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 1: Executive Summary & Objective
text: Section 1: Executive Summary & Objective FinBase Technologies Private Limited ('FinBase') operates a regulated digital lending platform in partnership with licensed Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs) and Scheduled Commercial Banks. The objective of this Personal Loans Master Policy is to provide transparent, standardized, and legally binding guidelines regarding underwriting criteria, loan tenure, interest pricing mechanisms, loan servicing, default penalties, and loan closure workflows. This document serves as the single source of truth for both customer-facing interactions and internal underwriting operations.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 2: Borrower Eligibility Criteria
text: Section 2: Borrower Eligibility Criteria

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 2.1 Age and Nationality Applicants must be Indian citizens residing wi
text: 2.1 Age and Nationality Applicants must be Indian citizens residing within Indian territorial boundaries at the time of application. • Minimum Age: 21 years completed at the date of loan application submission. • Maximum Age: 58 years at loan application (or 60 years at the scheduled loan maturity date, whichever is earlier).

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 2.2 Employment and Monthly Income Thresholds
text: 2.2 Employment and Monthly Income Thresholds • Salaried Individuals: • Minimum net monthly in-hand salary of ₹25,000 credited directly via bank transfer (IMPS/NEFT/RTGS). Cash or bearer cheque salary disbursements are strictly inadmissible. • Minimum continuous employment of 6 months with the current employer, and minimum 12 months total verifiable work experience. • Self-Employed Professionals & Sole Proprietors: • Minimum net monthly business income of ₹35,000, verified via the last 2 consecutive financial years of Income Tax Returns (ITR) with Computation of Income and audited balance sheets. • Business vintage of at least 24 continuous months in the same line of business at the registered operating address.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 2.3 Bureau Credit Score and Repayment History
text: 2.3 Bureau Credit Score and Repayment History • Minimum Score Requirement: A bureau score (TransUnion CIBIL or Experian) of not less than 720 is mandatory. • Delinquency Constraints: • Zero Days Past Due (DPD) occurrences across all active credit facilities over the trailing 12 months. • No write-offs, settlements, or restructured loan flags on record within the last 36 months. • Total existing Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio (FOIR) must not exceed 55% including the proposed FinBase EMI.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 3: Loan Quantums, Slabs, and Tenure Options
text: Section 3: Loan Quantums, Slabs, and Tenure Options FinBase offers personal loan facilities structured into standardized quantum bands based on verified income and risk scoring: Loan Slab Code Minimum Amount Maximum Amount Permitted Tenures (Months) Target Segment PL-MICRO ₹50,000 ₹1,50,000 12, 18, 24 First-time Borrowers PL-CORE ₹1,50,001 ₹5,00,000 12, 24, 36, 48 Mid-income Salaried PL-PRIME ₹5,00,001 ₹10,00,000 24, 36, 48, 60 High-income Salaried PL-EXECUTIVE ₹10,00,001 ₹15,00,000 36, 48, 60 Executive Tier (Income > ₹1.5L/mo)

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 4: Interest Rate Mechanics & Processing Fees
text: Section 4: Interest Rate Mechanics & Processing Fees

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 4.1 Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Personal loan interest rates are fixe
text: 4.1 Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Personal loan interest rates are fixed throughout the contracted tenure, calculated on a monthly reducing balance method. • Base APR Tier 1 (CIBIL 780+): 10.49% to 11.99% per annum. • Base APR Tier 2 (CIBIL 750 to 779): 12.00% to 13.99% per annum. • Base APR Tier 3 (CIBIL 720 to 749): 14.00% to 16.99% per annum.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 4.2 Upfront Processing Charges
text: 4.2 Upfront Processing Charges • Standard processing fee is 1.5% of the gross sanctioned loan amount, subject to a minimum of ₹1,000 and a maximum of ₹15,000. • Goods and Services Tax (GST) at 18% is applicable over and above the processing fee and is deducted upfront from the disbursed proceeds. • Disbursal stamp duty and e-mandate registration fees (₹150 to ₹400 depending on state of execution) are borne by the borrower.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 5: Repayment, EMI Mandate, and Default Penalties
text: Section 5: Repayment, EMI Mandate, and Default Penalties

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 5.1 Automated Clearing Mandate
text: 5.1 Automated Clearing Mandate • All repayments must be executed via automated electronic mandates: NACH, e-NACH, or UPI AutoPay. • EMIs are debited on the 5th calendar day of each month. If the 5th is a bank holiday, debit is initiated on the preceding working day.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — 5.2 Bounce and Overdue Penalties
text: 5.2 Bounce and Overdue Penalties • Cheque/Mandate Bounce Charge: ₹500 + 18% GST per bounce occurrence. • Penal Interest: Overdue EMIs attract penal interest at 2.0% per month (24% per annum) calculated on the overdue amount from due date to actual realization date.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 6: Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines
text: Section 6: Prepayment, Part-Payment, and Foreclosure Guidelines

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 6.1: Part-Prepayment Terms
text: Section 6.1: Part-Prepayment Terms • Part-prepayment is permitted only after completing a minimum of 6 consecutive monthly EMI cycles from the disbursal date. • Borrowers may part-prepay up to 25% of the current outstanding principal balance once per financial year without attracting any penalty. • If part-prepayment exceeds 25% of the outstanding principal in a single financial year, an administrative charge of 1.0% + GST is levied on the amount exceeding the 25% threshold.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 6.2: Foreclosure Charges & Rules
text: Section 6.2: Foreclosure Charges & Rules • The applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal if the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months of the repayment tenure. • If the loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the foreclosure charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal. • Full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from loan disbursal under any circumstances. • Foreclosure requests can be initiated directly via the FinBase App under 'Loans -> Service Requests -> Foreclose Loan'.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 6.3: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) and Lien Discharge
text: Section 6.3: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) and Lien Discharge • Upon settlement of all principal, accrued interest, and foreclosure fees, an authenticated digital No-Objection Certificate (NOC) is generated within 3 business days. • FinBase updates credit reporting bureaus (CIBIL, Experian, Equifax, CRIF High Mark) within 15 calendar days from the date of final loan closure.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — Section 22: Dispute Arbitration and Customer Grievance Redressal
text: Section 22: Dispute Arbitration and Customer Grievance Redressal FinBase enforces a strict 3-tier customer grievance escalation mechanism: • Level 1 (Support Executive): In-app chat ticket or email to `support@finbase.com`. Resolution TAT: 48 hours. • Level 2 (Grievance Officer): If unsatisfied with Level 1, escalate to `grievance.loans@finbase.com`. Resolution TAT: 5 working days. • Level 3 (Principal Nodal Officer & RBI Ombudsman): Unresolved disputes beyond 30 days can be appealed directly to the RBI CMS portal (`cms.rbi.org.in`).

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months? (Operational case 1) According to FinBase Personal Loan Policy Section 4.2, because the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months, the applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-001]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0001. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q002
text: Q002: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 26 months? (Operational case 2) As per Section 4.2, if the personal loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the applicable charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-002]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0002. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q003
text: Q003: Can I close my personal loan within 3 months of getting it? (Operational case 3) No. Under Section 4.2 of the FinBase Personal Loan Policy, full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from the date of loan disbursal. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-003]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-04. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0003. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q004
text: Q004: How much part-prepayment can I make without paying any fee? (Operational case 4) Under Section 4.1, you can part-prepay up to 25% of the outstanding principal balance once per financial year with zero penalty, provided you have paid at least 6 consecutive EMIs. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-004]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-01. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0004. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q005
text: Q005: What happens if my monthly EMI bounces due to insufficient funds? (Operational case 5) Under Section 5.2, an EMI bounce attracts a bounce charge of ₹500 + GST, along with penal interest of 2% per month on the overdue EMI amount until paid. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-005]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0005. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q006
text: Q006: What is the minimum monthly income to qualify for a salaried personal loan? (Operational case 6) Salaried applicants must have a minimum net monthly in-hand salary of ₹25,000 credited directly to their bank account, as outlined in Section 2.2. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-006]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0006. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q007
text: Q007: What is the minimum credit score required by FinBase for personal loans? (Operational case 7) A minimum bureau credit score (CIBIL or Experian) of 720 is required under Section 2.3. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-007]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-04. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0007. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q008
text: Q008: What is the maximum personal loan amount available at FinBase? (Operational case 8) The maximum loan amount is ₹15,00,000 (15 Lakhs) under Section 3, subject to credit underwriting and income verification. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-008]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-01. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0008. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q009
text: Q009: What are the available loan repayment tenures? (Operational case 9) FinBase offers tenure options of 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60 months as detailed in Section 3. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-009]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0009. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

(Operational case 18) The maximum loan amount is ₹15,00,000 (15 Lakhs) under Section 3, subject to credit underwriting and income verification. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-018]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0018. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q019
text: Q019: What are the available loan repayment tenures? (Operational case 19) FinBase offers tenure options of 12, 24, 36, 48, and 60 months as detailed in Section 3. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-019]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-04. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0019. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q020
text: Q020: What processing fee is charged on loan approval? (Operational case 20) Under Section 4.2, the processing fee is 1.5% of the sanctioned loan amount + 18% GST (minimum ₹1,000, maximum ₹15,000). [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-020]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-01. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0020. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q021
text: Q021: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan in 18 months? (Operational case 21) According to FinBase Personal Loan Policy Section 4.2, because the loan is closed prior to completing 24 months, the applicable foreclosure charge is 3% of the outstanding principal balance plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-021]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0021. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q022
text: Q022: What is the foreclosure charge if I close my personal loan after 26 months? (Operational case 22) As per Section 4.2, if the personal loan is foreclosed after completing 24 months, the applicable charge is reduced to 1.5% of the outstanding principal plus 18% GST. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-022]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-03. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0022. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q023
text: Q023: Can I close my personal loan within 3 months of getting it? (Operational case 23) No. Under Section 4.2 of the FinBase Personal Loan Policy, full foreclosure is strictly not permitted within the initial 6 months from the date of loan disbursal. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-023]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-04. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0023. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 3 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q024
text: Q024: How much part-prepayment can I make without paying any fee? (Operational case 24) Under Section 4.1, you can part-prepay up to 25% of the outstanding principal balance once per financial year with zero penalty, provided you have paid at least 6 consecutive EMIs. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-024]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-01. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0024. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 1 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase Personal Loans Master Policy & Operational Manual — FAQ Q025
text: Q025: What happens if my monthly EMI bounces due to insufficient funds? (Operational case 25) Under Section 5.2, an EMI bounce attracts a bounce charge of ₹500 + GST, along with penal interest of 2% per month on the overdue EMI amount until paid. [Reference Policy Section: Clause PL-REG-025]. • Applicability: All retail borrowers under loan tier code PL-02. • Verification note: Checked automatically via core lending system rule PL-VAL-0025. • Exception criteria: Any deviation requires approval from Risk Level 2 Underwriting Manager. • Escalation SLA: 24 business hours for credit review.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Preamble
text: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document Document Code: FB-POL-KYC-SEC-2026-V5 Effective Date: October 1, 2026 Issuing Authority: FinBase Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) & Legal Compliance Classification: Master Regulatory Policy & Security Standards Table of Contents

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 1: Customer Identification and KYC Tiers
text: Section 1: Customer Identification and KYC Tiers • Minimum KYC (Digital Onboarding): • Completed instantly via Aadhaar OTP validation. • Monthly credit transaction limit: ₹10,000. Annual cumulative limit: ₹1,00,000. • Validity: Strictly valid for 12 months, within which Full Video KYC must be completed to prevent account restriction. • Full KYC (Unrestricted): • Completed via Video KYC (V-KYC) or in-person verification. • Removes all balance and transaction limits; unlocks personal loans, credit cards, and wealth management.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 2: Officially Valid Documents (OVD) Accepted
text: Section 2: Officially Valid Documents (OVD) Accepted In accordance with RBI Master Directions on KYC, FinBase accepts the following 5 Officially Valid Documents for identity and address verification: 1. Aadhaar Card (Via UIDAI DigiLocker OTP or masked paper e-Aadhaar). 2. PAN Card (Mandatory for credit cards, personal loans, and deposits exceeding ₹50,000). 3. Indian Passport (Must be valid and unexpired). 4. Driving License (Smart card or verifiable DigiLocker document). 5. Voter ID Card (Issued by the Election Commission of India).

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 3: Video KYC Process, Timings, and Prerequisites
text: Section 3: Video KYC Process, Timings, and Prerequisites • Operating Hours: Video KYC agents are available **Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST** (closed on national holidays). • Prerequisites for the Customer: • Original physical PAN card in hand (laminated original card; screenshots or photocopies are strictly rejected). • A blank white sheet of paper and a black or blue pen for live on-camera signature capture. • High-speed internet connection and active smartphone/laptop camera and microphone. • Device geolocation (GPS) must be enabled to verify physical presence within India during the video session.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 4: Account Inactivity, Dormancy, and Reactivation
text: Section 4: Account Inactivity, Dormancy, and Reactivation • Inactive Account: An account with no customer-initiated financial transactions for **12 continuous months** is classified as Inactive. • Dormant Account: If no customer transactions occur for **24 continuous months**, the account automatically transitions to Dormant status. • Reactivation Procedure: Reactivation cannot be performed over phone support. The customer must complete a 1-minute digital re-KYC self-declaration and video verification via the FinBase App.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 5: Electronic Fraud & Zero Liability Policy
text: Section 5: Electronic Fraud & Zero Liability Policy FinBase enforces RBI Customer Protection Guidelines regarding unauthorized electronic banking transactions: • Zero Liability (100% Refund): • Applies when unauthorized fraud occurs due to contributory negligence, fraud, or deficiency on the part of FinBase. • Applies in third-party breaches where the customer notifies FinBase within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert. • Limited Liability: • If reported between 4 to 7 calendar days, customer liability is capped at ₹5,000 (or transaction value, whichever is lower). • Beyond 7 Days: • Customer liability is determined based on bank board-approved dispute review and case investigation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 6: Emergency Account & Card Blocking Protocols
text: Section 6: Emergency Account & Card Blocking Protocols • Instant In-App Freeze: Open FinBase App -> Security -> Toggle 'Freeze All Cards' to immediately disable POS, online, and ATM transactions. • 24/7 Dedicated Fraud Helpline: Call toll-free **1800-FIN-BASE (1800-346-2273)** or email `fraud-alert@finbase.com`.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — Section 7: Information Security Architecture & Telemetry Standards 7
text: Section 7: Information Security Architecture & Telemetry Standards 7 Information Security Standard FB-SEC-STD-007 mandates AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. All customer interaction sessions are audited via tamper-evident cryptographic append-only logs. • Standard 7.1: Biometric authentication key exchange and hardware security module (HSM) isolation. • Standard 7.2: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) enforcement for transactions above ₹2,000. • Standard 7.3: Device binding protocol via cellular SMS cryptographic challenge-response. • Standard 7.4: Root and jailbreak detection preventing app execution on compromised operating systems. • Standard 7.5: Periodic cyber resilience testing and vulnerability disclosure program. • Standard 7.6: Insider threat monitoring and privileged access workstation segregation. • Standard 7.7: Incident reporting to Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In). text: Section 23: KYC & Security FAQ Directory (Items 1 - 100)

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q001
text: Q001: What documents are required to complete Video KYC verification? (Security case 1) Under Section 3, you need your original physical PAN card, a blank white sheet of paper, and a blue/black pen for live signature capture, with GPS enabled in India. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-001]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-02. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0001. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q002
text: Q002: What are the operating hours for Video KYC agents? (Security case 2) Under Section 3, Video KYC agents are available Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM IST (excluding national holidays). [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-002]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-03. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0002. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q003
text: Q003: When does an account become dormant due to inactivity? (Security case 3) Under Section 4, an account becomes Inactive after 12 continuous months of no customer transactions, and becomes Dormant after 24 continuous months. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-003]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-01. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0003. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q004
text: Q004: What is the customer liability policy if fraud is reported within 3 days? (Security case 4) Under Section 5, customers have Zero Liability (100% refund) if third-party electronic fraud is reported within 3 calendar days of receiving the transaction alert. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-004]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-02. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0004. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q005
text: Q005: What is the emergency helpline number to report fraud or freeze my cards? (Security case 5) Under Section 6, the 24/7 toll-free fraud helpline is 1800-FIN-BASE (1800-346-2273) or email fraud-alert@finbase.com. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-005]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-03. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0005. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q006
text: Q006: What Officially Valid Documents (OVD) are accepted for KYC? (Security case 6) Under Section 2, FinBase accepts 5 OVDs: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport, Driving License, and Voter ID Card. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-006]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-01. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0006. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q007
text: Q007: What is the transaction limit on a Minimum KYC account? (Security case 7) Under Section 1, Minimum KYC accounts have a monthly credit limit of ₹10,000 and an annual limit of ₹1,00,000, valid for 12 months. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-007]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-02. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0007. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.

citation: FinBase KYC Verification, Compliance & Security Master Document — FAQ Q008
text: Q008: Can I complete Video KYC using a scanned soft copy of my PAN card? (Security case 8) No. Under Section 3, you must show the original physical PAN card to the camera. Photocopies or digital scans on screens are strictly rejected. [Reference KYC & Security Manual: Clause SEC-POL-008]. • Verification Protocol: Regulated under RBI Master Directions KYC-SEC-DIR-03. • Security Event Log: Captured under SIEM audit stream SEC-LOG-0008. • Escalation Protocol: Dispatched directly to FinBase Incident Response Team. • Regulatory reporting window: Within 6 hours of incident confirmation.
